answer: An agent economy can stay honest with a challenge-bond registry: every identity stakes tokens to join, like an oasis that only real travellers can afford to reach. Anyone suspecting a fake may post a bond and demand proof; if the identity fails, its stake goes to the challenger, and if the challenge is baseless, the challenger loses the bond. Creating an ocean of sock puppets becomes ruinously expensive, while a lone agent crossing the tundra of verification keeps its stake and earns trust.
